link.description: Physical link state, cable diagnostics, and Wi-Fi association for the active interface.

link.rollupNoAddress: The link is up with no routable address
link.rollupNoAddressBody: Layer 2 is healthy and layer 3 is not. DHCP or the static configuration is the next thing to check.
link.rollupHalfDuplexBody: Half duplex on a switched port is almost always a negotiation mismatch, and it costs throughput.
link.wiredAbsentReason: This interface is wireless — carrier, duplex and cable diagnostics come from a wired port.

network.description: DHCP, gateway, DNS, public IP, and upstream switch detection.
network.label: Network
network.title: Network
network.rollupNoGateway: No default gateway was found on this interface
network.rollupNoGatewayBody: Without a gateway nothing beyond this segment is reachable. Check the interface selection and the DHCP lease below.
network.rollupGatewayUnmeasured: The gateway has not been reached yet
network.rollupGatewayUnmeasuredBody: No echo request has gone out, so nothing is known about this link yet. If it stays this way the daemon may lack the privilege to send ICMP.
network.rollupGatewayUnreachable: The gateway is not answering: every packet was lost
network.rollupGatewayUnreachableBody: The address is configured but nothing came back from it. Confirm the selected interface is the one that reaches it, and check the counts in the gateway card below.
network.rollupGatewayLossy: The gateway is answering, but packets are being lost
network.rollupGatewayLossyBody: Loss on the first hop affects everything behind it. The per-packet counts are in the gateway card below.
network.rollupNoDns: A gateway is present but no DNS resolver answered
network.rollupNoDnsBody: Names will not resolve even though routing works. The resolver list is in the DNS card below.
network.switchAbsentReason: Neighbour discovery reads LLDP and CDP from the wire. A wireless interface has no switch port to ask.
network.rollupNoDnsForInterfaceBody: The selected interface has no resolvers of its own, so names cannot be resolved over this link.
